communications.subject: RE: Clarification on Morning Integration Spike
communications.body: We confirm routine connector maintenance occurred on our side between 02:00 and 02:30 IST on October 12. However, our records show no scheduled task or authorized engineer initiated a bulk learner export at 03:17 IST. Furthermore, our authorized production connector egress node is strictly 10.10.4.12. We are investigating whether an API secret was inadvertently disclosed in past ticket threads.

communications.subject: URGENT: Credential and Source Verification
communications.body: Please confirm the active credential ID, authorized source IPs, and last rotation date for client rollcall-prod. Do NOT send raw secrets over this communication channel.
